# Karyvo AI Builder

> India-first AI career platform and ATS resume optimizer grounded in Laszlo Bock's XYZ formula.

## Products & Capabilities
- **Master Career Profile**: Unified repository of career milestones, education, and technical competencies.
- **ATS Resume Builder**: Generates verified, clean single-column ATS-friendly resumes with PDF and plain-text export.
- **Standalone ATS Scanner**: Upload any PDF or text resume to audit formatting flaws, keyword density, and parse compatibility.
- **XYZ Bullet Optimizer**: Transforms rough notes into quantifiable achievements using the Google XYZ formula: "Accomplished [X], as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]".
- **Role Mock Interview**: Simulates realistic behavioral and technical interview questions based on specific job descriptions.
- **Targeted Cover Letter**: Crafts tailored cover letters aligned with specific job descriptions.

## Pricing & Availability
- **Starter Plan**: ₹0 (Free forever, includes ATS scoring and resume building).
- **Karyvo Pro**: ₹99 one-time (Unlimited ATS audits, AI bullet rewriting, mock interview simulator).

## Engineering & Privacy Philosophy
- **Factual Grounding**: Never invents metrics, fake percentages, or imaginary achievements.
- **ATS Compliance**: Single-column document architecture eliminates technical parsing errors from tables or floating text boxes.
- **Privacy First**: Supabase Row-Level Security (RLS) ensures only authenticated owners can access career data. Never sold to third-party recruiters or used to train public models.
